system.description:
Ornate carved bone tube holding up to 10 scrolls of any size; mentally produces whichever scroll the bearer desires upon grasping. Speaking the command word ("Ekintzart", inscribed on a scroll inside) elongates it into a Quarterstaff +1.

When Found: 20% chance of holding a 1st-level MU or Cleric scroll with [[/r 1d4+1]] spells, plus 10% chance of a random ward scroll.
